# Now at the ALBERTINA Museum

### Albertinaplatz 1, Vienna

[The audience room in the state rooms of the ALBERTINA is decorated entirely in red: The seating, walls and curtains are covered in red fabric. A large, dark painting with a golden border hangs on the wall. On two of the walls, a mirror covers almost the entire height of the wall. In front of the mirror on the floor are tables with candlesticks on them. White, gathered curtains and red, floor-length side panels with golden embroidery hang in front of the windows. Two large crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling. State Rooms](/en/exhibitions/state-rooms/)
